rationale: This is a near-verbatim rediscovery of the archived "Equity-Cushion R&D Margin Runway" (identical three components and hypothesis text), differing only by replacing the outer MUL with SUMRANK — a cosmetic aggregation change, not a substantive refinement of a signal that already produced fmb 1.18 / ls_talpha 0.93.

Adding a lagged own-history goodwill-state gate to the archived "Post-Acquisition Debt Cleanup" is a genuine conditional refinement that plausibly targets the fmb/alpha disagreement (strong slope, negligible spread alpha), though it remains a same-family extension and the unranked LAG(TS_RANK) leg makes the triple product's effective weighting hard to interpret.

This is the archived "Debt-Funded Goodwill Margin Decay" with the financing leg swapped from liability growth to sstk/at, and that swapped leg is itself the well-documented equity/net-share-issuance anomaly, so the triple rank product will largely reload on a known effect at ~5% coverage.

A one-leg substitution on the archived "Rollover Brand-Capital Cut" (established-advertiser gate replaced by margin decay) applied to the same weak, ~4%-coverage advertising universe; internally consistent but too incremental given the parent's wrong-signed FMB slope and insignificant alpha.

TS_COUNT(xrd,5) is effectively an R&D-reporter dummy (mostly 0 or 5), a coarse and already-known firm characteristic, so this reduces to the archived "Liability-Light R&D Persistence" with a degraded innovation leg plus a margin term rather than a new mechanism.

Conditioning the archived stop-go volatility pair on realized margin improvement, with the sign flipped to match that signal's contrary +2.78 alpha, is a legitimate evidence-driven refinement with a stated mechanism, but the flip is partly post-hoc and volatility-of-liabilities interactions risk proxying for small/distressed firms rather than "option exercise."
